title: Rodriguez paper proposing to test DMT entities with prime factorization

tellings.quote: back in the early 2000s, uh a guy called Rodriguez published this paper

plain: In the early 2000s, a man named Rodriguez is said to have published a paper proposing a test for the beings that people on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, say they meet: ask them to break a large number down into prime factors, a sum too hard to do in your head. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore mentions the paper to Michels in passing. The idea is that if the beings got it right, they would look like real, separate minds and not the user's imagination.
